system.biography:
Background

Embraced in 412 A.D. as a Roman patrician's protégé, Gracis Nostinus survived the murder of his beloved sire Marius by their barbarian blood-brother Hrothulf — a betrayal Gracis has never stopped avenging in spirit, blaming Rome's entire fall on the loss of men like Marius. Fleeing to the New World over the centuries, Gracis has built one of the largest personal followings in Milwaukee's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} and now openly campaigns to become the city's next Prince following the previous Prince's death, believing only strong central rule can save Milwaukee from the factional war threatening to draw Justicar attention. He speaks six languages fluently and cultivates an image as an effete, fussy intellectual, but commands genuine political weight through eight Retainers and extensive Influence, Resources, and Allies.

Roleplaying Hints

Prim, effeminate, and fastidious — wipes his hands after any physical contact, speaks through his nose, hunches to seem shorter than his five feet. Underneath the foppish affect is a serious, patient political operator obsessed with restoring order.
system.notes: Sire: Marius (slain by Hrothulf, Marius's own childe, in a sudden frenzy circa 412 A.D.). Rival: Hrothulf. Haven: a luxurious waterfront home north of Downtown. Disciplines as printed: Auspex 3, Dominate 4, Fortitude 3, Presence 4 (capped above to this system's 1-5 scale).

system.description: When issuing a Dominate command, spend a Blood Trait and decide how many future attempts to resist or recover memories you wish to crush, spending one Mental Trait per attempt (these Traits are unavailable the rest of the night, though Willpower expenditure restores them normally). If the subject tries to disobey or recover memories within that limit, agonizing pain incapacitates him for 10 minutes; the power fades once all guarded attempts have been used.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait, plus one Mental Trait per resisted attempt crushed
system.duration: Until the set number of resistance attempts are exhausted

system.description: Spend a Willpower Trait and win a normal Mental Challenge against a familiar target, regardless of distance, to establish mental contact as though eye contact had been made. Once contact is established, Dominate may be used on the subject normally; using this against another supernatural being costs an additional Willpower Trait.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus one more against supernaturals)
system.duration: As per the Dominate power used

items.name: Presence — 2 Intermediate — Command the Wary Steed

system.description:
Through use of this power the Cainite can cause enemies' mounts to rear and bolt, singly or en masse, by the strength of his gaze alone, or bolster the courage and tractability of allied steeds for greater control in battle.

System: The player spends a Willpower point and rolls Manipulation + Animal Ken (difficulty 7). Enemy mounts become terrified and nigh uncontrollable: Ride roll difficulties increase by three and mounted combat becomes impossible. Friendly mounts become far more pliant (-2 difficulty on all Ride rolls) and may be coerced into situations they would normally avoid.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots

system.description: By winning a Social Challenge, you render the target favorably disposed toward you for the rest of the scene or an hour, unable to insult or attack you unless you act against them first.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: A combination power blending Potence's unnatural strength with Fortitude's supernatural toughness, letting a Cainite brace her whole body against blunt-force impacts: falling, car crashes, explosions, or being struck by very large objects. It does not help against ordinary combat damage (fists, bullets, blades) or against fire, electricity, sunlight, or other energy-based damage — only against impacts affecting the entire body, and only if the character can see the impact coming and brace for it.
system.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Five: Storytelling (Unique Abilities)

vtmlarp.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred
